retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, sepia-toned concert photograph featuring a musician with an acoustic guitar under dramatic stage lighting with a visible halftone texture.

recipe.visualDefinition: A low-key, monochromatic sepia image of a male musician performing with an acoustic guitar. The scene is defined by harsh, directional stage lighting that creates blown-out highlights on the performer's hands and face, while the rest of the frame remains in deep, textured shadow with a prominent mechanical halftone dot pattern.
coreVisualRelationships: Musician centered behind a large acoustic guitar foreground
Raised hands framing the head and catching intense light
Textured dark background contrasting with bright white light flares
Typography anchored to the top-left corner in a flush-left block
coreInvariants: Sepia or warm monochromatic color grade
Visible halftone screen texture across the entire image
High-contrast lighting with minimal midtone detail

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The musician is the central focus, partially obscured by a large acoustic guitar in the lower-left foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The musician's face and the microphone stand serve as the central vertical anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the bright highlights of the raised hands down to the face, then follows the guitar neck across the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy, dark negative space occupies the upper-right and lower-right quadrants, emphasizing the light sources.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep umber and dark brown shadows
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation, high value contrast between deep blacks and blown-out whites.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used for all text elements to maintain a clean, modernist contrast against the gritty photo.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric 1970s aesthetic and tight tracking.
Provides the clean, monolinear geometric look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast sepia concert photo of a musician with an acoustic guitar, featuring dramatic stage lighting, blown-out highlights on raised hands, and a heavy halftone dot texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a left-aligned block of geometric sans-serif text in the top-left corner using an off-white color with tight line spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly warm sepia/brown?
Is the text left-aligned in the top-left corner?
Are the highlights on the hands sufficiently bright?

mustRedesign: Ensure text does not overlap the main subject's face

avoid: Digital noise instead of film grain

postGenerationChecks: Check for halftone consistency across dark and light areas
Verify the sepia tone is not too orange or yellow
Ensure the guitar is a prominent foreground element
Confirm the text is legible but secondary to the image
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast sepia photography + Halftone screen + Geometric Sans-Serif typography (top-left) = 1970s Folk-Rock Aesthetic.
